description: Graphe de la mobilité - Graphe routier is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. GRAPHE DE LA MOBILITE - GRAPHE ROUTIER: Ce graphe regroupe les graphes de base géométrique des troncons et des jonctions (carrefours, arrêts, gares, débarcadères) qui sont les points de connexions, de transferts entre les différents graphes. Ces graphes représentent les différentes voies physiques (et non virtuelles, comme une ligne de bus) de la cirulation. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
